texts: The platform consists of a two-node MicroK8s cluster running on AWS g5.xlarge instances.
Each AWS g5.xlarge instance contains one NVIDIA A10G GPU.
Phase 2.8 expanded the platform from one node to two nodes.
Phase 2.9 validated dual GPU inference scaling.
Single GPU throughput at 1024 users was 67.52 requests per second.
Dual GPU throughput at 1024 users was 135.63 requests per second.
Dual GPU scaling efficiency was approximately 2.01x.
Average latency improved from 14.49 seconds to 7.37 seconds after adding a second GPU.
P95 latency improved from 16.0 seconds to 8.5 seconds after adding a second GPU.
The platform runs MicroK8s version 1.35.6.
Qwen Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is deployed on Node 1.
Microsoft Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct is deployed on Node 2.
The service vllm-qwen routes traffic only to the Qwen model.
The service vllm-phi3 routes traffic only to the Phi-3 model.
Qdrant is used as the vector database for retrieval augmented generation.
Open WebUI is used as the user interface.
Prometheus is used for metrics collection.
Grafana is used for dashboards and visualization.
Loki is used for log aggregation.
Tempo is used for distributed tracing.
The worker node hostname is ip-172-31-6-36.
The primary node hostname is ip-172-31-7-23.
The Deepak secret validation code is RAG-DEMO-2026-XYZ.
Qwen pod recovery time after deletion was 112 seconds.
Phi-3 pod recovery time after deletion was 103 seconds.
Worker node failure detection took approximately 43 seconds.
Worker node recovery required approximately 225 seconds after restart.
The platform provides pod level self healing.
The platform does not currently provide node level high availability.
Node level failover is limited by node selectors and local hostpath storage.
